skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Rigid Arm: Deal 120% AT DMG to a single target, and deal 8% of Max HP as extra DMG.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Kabuto Knuckle: Deal damage to a single target with 2 consecutive strikes for 210% AT DMG. Heal self for 20% of Max HP. If the 2nd phase deals Crit DMG, 100% chance to inflict [Injury] for 2 rounds (when attacked, takes Injury DMG of 50% ATK).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Kabuto Knuckle (Ultra-Ultimate): Deal damage to a single target with 2 consecutive strikes for 210% > 262% AT DMG. Heal self for 20% > 35% of Max HP. If the 2nd phase does NOT deal Crit DMG, there's a 100% chance to afflict the main target with [Injury] for 2 rounds (when attacked, deal a follow-up attack of 50% > 80% ATK as extra DMG).

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Kabuto Armor: When attacked, reflect 20% of DMG taken onto all enemies (only one effect of the same type per battle). Permanently increase HP.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Kabuto Armor (Extreme): When attacked, reflect 30% of DMG taken onto all enemies (only one effect of the same type per battle). Permanently increase HP.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Kabuto Armor (5P): When attacked, reflect 35% of DMG taken onto all enemies (only one effect of the same type per battle). Permanently increase HP.
